jobs.description: Mobile app demos: Phone not required – Demostack Your product demo isn’t complete without showing your mobile app. It’s finally time to demo it with ease and professionalism. Get a demo How to demo your app from your laptop? Upload app Search for and upload your app into Demostack. Do it once, everyone can avoid connecting a mobile phone forever. No R&D needed. Tailor the product story Customize the content to your buyer’s use case, persona, or vertical. Showcase and share Deliver personalized live demos and let buyers play around with your app on their terms with a Sandbox and Tour leave-behind. Mobile demos, the missing ingredient in your sales motion Until today, demoing your mobile app could prove difficult or even impossible, resulting in missed revenue opportunities. This is a shame, considering that your mobile app may set your sales motion apart and serve as a key competitive advantage. Equip your sales team with everything they need to win deals - including the ability to demo your mobile app. Launch cable-free, phone-free mobile app demos in seconds Today, even if your sales team can demo their mobile app, it's not easy. Cable connections and 3rd-party apps can lead to broken demos. During mobile demos, unprofessional home screens and embarrassing notifications can derail a deal. With Demostack, set up your mobile demo once for the whole org, empowering sales to showcase your mobile app without the need for repetitive setups. Demo it alongside your web app demos from one unified platform that is built for demoing. No distractions or pop-ups. Feature breakdown Phone-free mobile demos Set up your mobile demo once for the whole org 1-click mobile demo launch Customize mobile demos Show your web app side by side with your mobile app Show a mobile demo with admin view and user view Share a mobile demo leave-behind Frequently Asked Questions How can I demo my mobile app with Demostack? To demo your mobile app with Demostack, you'll need to perform a one-time implementation. Demostack will generate a shareable link for your mobile app. This link can then be used alongside web app demos. This one-time implementation frees sales from connecting a mobile phone forever. No R&D needed. How can I share my mobile app during a demo? Sharing your mobile app during a demo is straightforward. Utilize the shareable link created with Demostack and perform a screen share from your desktop. This allows you to showcase both your web app and mobile app side-by-side in real-time. Do I need a cellphone to demo the mobile app with Demostack? No, you don't need a mobile phone for demos with Demostack. You can launch cable-free, phone-free mobile app demos in seconds. Can I send a mobile app leave-behind to my prospects? Absolutely. After a call with a prospect, you can create and send a Demostack Sandbox link. This enables your champion and other stakeholders to independently explore the app without your presence in the room. I don’t have an app, can I demo our web app's mobile interface? Yes, you can demo your web app's mobile interface using Demostack. Do I need Zoom? No, you can use any web conferencing tool that supports desktop screen sharing. There's no need to log in separately from your mobile phone and desktop app. Android or iOS? Currently, our beta product is designed for Android apps. However, if you have an iOS app, please still reach out, and we can explore compatibility options. Can I show 3rd party apps? If showcasing integrations with third-party apps is essential for your demo, feel free to talk to us to see if we can accommodate your requirements. Can I show my web app and mobile app interacting with each other? Yes, you can seamlessly demonstrate the interaction between your web app and mobile app from a single screen. There's no need to switch between tabs. Can I edit mobile demo content with Demostack? During the beta phase, our sales engineers will handle customizing your mobile app content for the demo. Do I need to send you my app source code? No. Your app source code is not required. How secure is the data and access to my mobile app on Demostack? Security is a priority for Demostack. We are certified SOC 2 Type I and Type II. What support and resources are available if I encounter issues with Demostack? Demostack offers dedicated customer support and resources to assist you with any issues or questions you may have while using our platform. What is the cost? Demostack's pricing structure may vary depending on your specific needs and usage. See our pricing page. The Customer Data relates to individuals who register as end-users, or otherwise interact with our customers’ demos via our Platform (“End-Users”); Demostack Website, CRM, and Prospects Data: data relating to customers, potential customers and visitors of our websites (Demostack.com or any other website in our control, on which this policy is presented), online ads and content, emails or communications under our control (“Websites” and “Visitors” respectively); Other Types of Data: Participant Information (as defined below) or any other data or information collected while otherwise interacting with us. The Website together with the Platform shall be referred to as “the Services”.Specifically, this Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding – Data Collection and Processing Data Uses Data Location Data Sharing Data Location Cookies and Tracking Technologies Communications Data Security Data Subject Rights Data Controller/Processor Additional Notice and Contact Details Please read this Privacy Policy carefully and make sure that you fully understand and agree to it. You are not legally required to provide us with any personal data, and may do so (or avoid doing so) at your own free will. If you do not wish to provide us with your personal data, or to have it processed by us or any of our Service Providers (as defined below), please avoid any interaction with us or use of our Services. When an End-User follows the link to the Demo and interacts with the Demo, we collect data on such End-User for the purpose of providing our Services (such as analytics or insights on engagement/interaction with a Demo) and we process such data only per the instructions and on behalf of our customer. Accordingly, whilst Demostack supports these laws by providing our customers with features and options for how they use our Services – our customer is solely responsible for determining whether and how they wish to use our Services and such features, and to ensure that the appropriate legal basis and all necessary notices for the processing of Customer Data have been established and provided, by the customer, prior to our processing it through the Platform. Users should not submit such data through the services unless specifically requested.
